Name: Pasta Fantastica Continued
Author: Shads4242
Description:
[b][size=4][center]About[/center][/size]

[/b]Presenting Pasta Fantastica Continued, an official conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13297]Pasta Fantastica[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lavliette?gameId=1303]Lavliette [/url]to run in Stardew 1.6 with Content Patcher. This mod has been made with their permission, and even features beautiful new spritework by them! 


[b][size=4][center]Current and Upcoming Features[/center][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]10 new Artisan Goods made exclusively using base game items
[*]1 new Artisan Machine, the Pasta Boiler
[*]Perfection Toggle (planned for v2.0)
[/list]
[b][size=4][center]FAQ[/center][/size][/b]
[b]Q1: How do I install this mod? 
A:[/b] Follow the steps below
[list=1]
[*]Download the mod from Nexus
[*]Unzip the folder and place it in your Mods folder
[*]launch the game
[*]have fun fulfilling your Italian dreams :) 
[/list]
[b]Q2: I ran into a bug, how do I fix this? 
A[/b]: Please make a bug report on the Bugs tab with a SMAPI Log. You can find instructions on how to share a SMAPI log at [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI's Log Parser[/url]﻿. Also include any other information you might think is relevant (config settings, what you were trying to do when you encountered the bug, etc). At bare minimum though I need a SMAPI log to diagnose and fix issues. Not providing a SMAPI log severely decreases the chances that I'll be able to fix any problems that arise. 

[b]Q3: Do I need any other mods aside from Content Patcher to play this mod?
A[/b]: The only other mod needed is Extra Machine Configs by Selph. Other than that, it requires no other mods.  

[b][size=4][center]Translations[/center][/size][/b]
This mod currently only has the English translation since I do not speak other languages fluently. If you wish to translate this mod please feel free to do so. If you send me your i18n file after doing so, I'll happily upload a new version of this mod with it included, and add your name to the list of credits. You can send me an i18n file by uploading it to [url=https://smapi.io/json]SMAPI's JSON validator[/url] and then sending me the link to it in a comment or PM. 

[u]Translation Credits
[/u]Lavliette and Shads42 - English
